notes: בְּקֶרֶב is split rather than fused here: the ASV writes 'in' for the preposition and 'the midst' for the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and the subtraction test finds each morpheme holding English of its own.
'stretch forth' keeps its particle with the verb — rule 44 names שָׁלַח → 'put forth' as one lexical verb plus its particle, so the head stays on 'stretch' and nothing is added.
s016 takes no subject pronoun: the explicit יְמִינֶךָ is the clause's subject and stands as its own unit, so rule 17's permission does not reach a pronoun here.

s018 יְמִין → 'right hand' heads on 'right' by rule 31's subtraction — יָד is the word that names a hand, and 'right' is what carries this substantive's lexeme. 'hand' as head is named in the unit's note under rule 8.
